subcategories.label: Public presence
subcategories.finding: CEO speaks at Space Symposium, MilSat Show, LA500-honored, Payload podcast.

subcategories.label: Integrity
subcategories.finding: No red flags across multiple sources; not exhaustively background-checked.

subcategories.label: Ownership of models

subcategories.finding: National-security/commercial satellite market venture-scale; AI-data-center expansion still aspirational.

subcategories.label: Valuation vs comps
subcategories.finding: [ESTIMATED] $6.8B/~$1B backlog premium to Astranis ($2.8B) and Apex ($2.3B).

subcategories.finding: Defense-budget dependency (Golden Dome, Space Force) is a tailwind, not near-term risk.

params.evidence: Fundamentals are largely undisclosed (typical for private hardware primes); backlog and contract wins are strong, but valuation looks rich versus closest comps.

subcategories.label: Entry multiple
subcategories.finding: Valuation justified by 2x backlog/valuation growth in 7 months, not cheap.

subcategories.label: Base-case MOIC
subcategories.finding: Entry at $6.8B late-stage mark caps realistic base-case MOIC upside.

subcategories.label: Exit path
subcategories.finding: Active Forge secondary trading plus defense-primes IPO precedent (Rocket Lab public).

subcategories.finding: Not modeled in this manual research pass; no future-round assumptions run.

subcategories.finding: No confirmed IPO timeline found; unmodeled hold period.

subcategories.finding: Deal-specific liq pref/pro-rata terms not publicly disclosed.

subcategories.finding: Forge lists active K2 Space secondary trading at $6.8B valuation.

params.evidence: Return case rests on strong backlog momentum and visible secondary demand, but entry valuation is already late-stage-rich, capping realistic base-case MOIC.

model_output.rationale: Genuine new-money Tier 1 lead (KP/ICONIQ) with strong follow-on and opportunistic timing aligns with ID8's core screen, but AI is purely aspirational, not structural - breaking the AI-mandate leg despite a rich, well-backed hardware business.
